items.author: midtown-solutions.bsky.social
items.context: What's your go-to fix when a game starts stuttering? #PCGaming #Gaming
items.text: Driver update first, then cap the frame rate a few fps below your monitor's refresh rate. That alone smooths out a lot of stutter.
